name: Same auth rename stretched across explore/test/edit turns
expected_edit: rename parse to verify, expiry, format_token

ops.text: Rename Token::parse to Token::verify in src/token.rs only. Leave callers broken for now.
Update src/auth.rs so login uses Token::verify.
Update src/session.rs so bind uses Token::verify.
Fix src/tests.rs to compile against verify.
Add an expires_at: u64 field on Token. Existing tokens expire at 9999.
verify must take now: u64 and return Err("expired") when expires_at < now. Keep the error type as String.
Thread now through auth::login and session::bind.
Session must not persist an expired token.
Add auth::format_token that logs only the token length, never the raw bytes.
Do not log raw token bytes anywhere.
Final pass: every caller compiles, expiry is a String error, format_token exists.
